description: Cursor operations inside nested BEGIN...END scripting blocks, via EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$...$$ RETURN values: a cursor declared and iterated in an inner block updating an outer variable, sequential and same-block cursors, cursors inside IF/ELSE bodies (executed or skipped), declared-outer-iterated-inner, nested FOR loops re-opening the inner cursor per outer iteration, triple nesting, an empty cursor leaving the variable unchanged, a cursor name re-used across sequential blocks without leakage, and a WHERE-filtered cursor.
